profile.numberingFormatHint: The numbers your documents receive: {TYPE} is the short type code, {TYPE_LABEL} the label from the table below, {YEAR} and {MONTH} the document's year and month, and {SEQ:03d} the running number, padded to as many digits as you write. profile.approvalWorkflowHint: Require approval before completing high-value or sensitive documents. The decision belongs to the "Approve requests" permission, not to a role name — any role carrying it, including a custom one, can approve.
profile.approvalHowItWorks: These settings decide what needs approval: a type listed below, or a net value above the threshold. The document workflow decides who approves — and an active workflow for documents with nothing set here makes every confirmed document wait. Purchase orders split it the same way, choosing "always" or a net total instead of a type list. Someone with the "Approve requests" permission must approve a waiting document before it can be completed and stock execution can happen.

profile.approvalThresholdHint: Documents above this value will require approval. Leave blank to disable value-based approval.

summary.skippedDecide: Answer every skipped line first: Undo skip, Backorder or Not coming.

error.approval_required: This document requires approval before receiving can start. Requesting it moves the document back to awaiting approval, where it stays until someone signs off.
error.refused: Your account cannot start this session. Ask an administrator of your organization if you should be able to.
error.start_failed: Failed to start the receiving session.
error.short_receive_failed: Failed to record the received quantity.
error.complete_failed: Failed to complete the receiving session.
error.cancel_failed: Failed to cancel the receiving session.
error.session_held: {{owner}} has an active receiving session on this document. Take it over to carry on from their scans, or discard their scans and start afresh.

scanSession.receiving: Receiving on this document is in progress, lines received: {{done}}/{{total}}. What was scanned is kept — continue it, or complete the document with what was received.
scanSession.picking: Picking on this document is in progress, lines picked: {{done}}/{{total}}. What was scanned is kept — continue it, or complete the document with what was picked.
scanSession.closeTitle: Discard the scans of this session?
scanSession.closeMessage: Discarding puts back every scan recorded in the session. This cannot be undone.
scanSession.closeFailed: The session could not be closed.
scanSession.closed: The scans of the session were discarded.
scanSession.finishedReceiving: The receiving scan is finished, but no stock is booked yet: the document books it when it is completed.
scanSession.finishedPicking: The picking scan is finished, but no stock is booked yet: the document books it when it is completed.
scanSession.finishedPacking: The picking scan is finished, but no stock is booked yet: complete the dispatch in the Packing step below, after packing if you need to.
scanSession.leftOpen: Paused — everything scanned so far is kept. Anyone can continue it, or complete the document with what was scanned.

permissions.readDesc: Can browse warehouse documents, the register and stock views
permissions.writeDesc: Can create, confirm and complete documents — this moves stock
permissions.manageDesc: Can cancel and delete documents, close inventory periods and edit document configuration
permissions.receiveOverToleranceDesc: Can record more goods than expected — or more than is left on an order line — past the over-receipt tolerance.

extraCosts.title: Delivery costs
extraCosts.subtitle: Freight, duty and insurance belong in the value of the goods they arrived with — and can only be added before the receipt is posted.
extraCosts.addFailed: The cost could not be added.
extraCosts.fellBack: A split by value needs values and a split by weight needs weights — where they were missing the cost was split by quantity instead.

openingStock.title: Opening stock from a sheet
openingStock.pleaseWait: Please wait while we build the receipt.
openingStock.note: Every row becomes a line of one draft receipt marked as opening stock. A product is found by barcode, SKU or exact name, or created on the way; the price goes into the cost layers when you post the draft. Nothing reaches the shelf until you confirm and complete it.
openingStock.draftReady: Draft {{number}} is ready to review and post.
openingStock.stubsCreated_one: {{count}} product the sheet named was created.
openingStock.stubsCreated_other: {{count}} products the sheet named were created.
openingStock.nothingLanded: No row could be read, so no draft was made. Fix the rows below and try again.
openingStock.failed: The sheet could not be imported

settings.overReceiptToleranceDescription: How far past the expected quantity — or past what is left on an order line — a receipt may go without the permission to receive over tolerance. 0% allows no surplus beyond it.
settings.overReceiptCeilingDescription: How far past the expected quantity — or past what is left on an order line — nobody may receive, not even someone who may receive over tolerance. 0% sets no ceiling.
settings.scanSessionIdleMinutes: Release an idle scanning session after (minutes)
settings.scanSessionIdleMinutesDescription: A picking or receiving session nobody has scanned in for this long stops holding its document: what was scanned is kept, and anyone can continue it or complete the document.
settings.moduleSubtitle: Numbering, printouts, approvals and the rules goods follow.
settings.receivingHint: How a receipt is checked against what was expected, and when a scanning session nobody is using lets go of its document.

unitMismatch.title: Units disagree
unitMismatch.message: {{product}} is kept in {{templateUnit}}, and this record would be saved in {{chosenUnit}}. Confirm to restate the record and this delivery into {{templateUnit}} — the choice lands in the record's history. To keep the units apart, change the record's unit on its page in Inventory first.

packing.title: Packing
packing.subtitle: Optional: put the picked goods into packages, print a slip and a label for each, then complete the dispatch.
packing.emptyPackage: Empty. Scan a product or tap a line above to fill it.
packing.label: Label
packing.qtyRequired: Enter how much goes into the package

errors.writeFailed: The packing change was not saved
errors.slipFailed: The packing slip could not be downloaded
errors.labelFailed: The label could not be downloaded

todo.decisionsSubtitle: Open one to decide — nothing here is confirmed, approved or released for you
todo.writeOffBody: {{quantity}} leave {{location}} for good. The document for the office is written automatically.
todo.membersFailed: The people to give tasks to could not be loaded.

ask.change: {{product}} usually goes elsewhere. Make {{location}} its home location from now on?

refused.quarantine: {{location}} is for goods set aside, so it cannot be the home location of {{product}}.
refused.not_stock: {{location}} does not take stock, so it cannot be the home location of {{product}}.

shipping.suggestionsFailed: Your carriers could not be loaded — type the name.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Everything that moved goods on a document. Every entry has its document, for print and for accounting. A quantity edited on a product is under Stock movements.
history.emptyDescription: Receive, issue or move goods and each action appears here with its document.
history.emptyPlannedDescription: Documents that are started but not done yet wait here.

register.hint: A summary for a period, with totals, to CSV

closeMonth.title: Close month
closeMonth.hint: After closing, nobody changes the entries of that month

newDocument.title: New document manually
newDocument.hint: {{types}} — when accounting asks for a specific one

documents.hint: Every document with filters by type, status and date

mistake.title: Something wrong in an entry?
mistake.body: Open it and choose “{{action}}”. A correction to that document is saved and the stock goes back to the truth.

start.title: What are we doing?
start.subtitle: Choose an action. The document for the office is saved automatically.
